svg.title: What tailing costs a monitor
svg.desc: Bytes downloaded per byte of new entries, against entries added per checkpoint, for entries of about 190 bytes. Fetching every partial bundle: 13.7 times at 10 entries per checkpoint, 2.7 at 75, 1.85 at 150, 1.62 at 200, 1.25 at 500, 1.04 at 3,000. Waiting for full bundles and fetching only the partial level 0 tile: 3.1, 1.28, 1.14, 1.10, 1.04, 1.01.

text.tspan: an MTC CA with a checkpoint every 2 s adds thousands per checkpoint: tailing costs almost nothing extra.
